text: Field correction from the completed exemplar run: NO leak. Clean instrumented 120-node run shows RSS oscillating 819-1466 MB with no net growth (slope 0.62 MB/node) and per-node time slope 0.0048 s/node; the earlier observed slowdown was contention from unrelated 6-day-old R processes. The real defect is the flat per-node cost: 9.03 s/node mean at q=8, ~50-voxel spheres, single-node at= API. 577-node sweep measured at ~90 min.
